definition_binding_for_ezekiel_proposed_.re_decision: A row is RE-DECIDED when any DECISION-BEARING ELEMENT changes without a ruling, boss work order or controlling-agent order that names the row and the element. The decision-bearing elements are: (a) span, unit_type, parent_collection — never open to a wave; (b) the confidence grade; (c) the IDENTITY of the strongest rejected alternative (which rival the row names as strongest); (d) the VERDICT on any named rival — licensed or unlicensed, live or refused; (e) the CLASS of the holding ground — text-signal evidence, over-split guard, cutting rule, or mark.
definition_binding_for_ezekiel_proposed_.grounds_repair: Everything else: a stated fact made true to the bytes; a false ground dropped where another STATED or ORDERED ground carries the same conclusion; an ordered disclosure added; the same ground restated accurately; a rival already named weighed more fully with the same verdict.
definition_binding_for_ezekiel_proposed_.the_test: A reader of the pre-wave row and a reader of the post-wave row arrive at the same seam, the same rival set with the same verdicts, and the same grade, for reasons that differ only in accuracy. If they would not, a decision-bearing element moved.
definition_binding_for_ezekiel_proposed_.the_stop: A false ground that is the row's ONLY ground, with no order supplying the replacement, is a STOP: the author records the falsity and escalates. The author never substitutes a ground of its own devising, and never returns to a ground it has measured false — OW-18 forbids both.
definition_binding_for_ezekiel_proposed_.ordered_changes_are_not_wave_re_decision: A change to (b)-(e) that a ruling ordered for that row is a controlling-agent decision executed by the wave. It is accountable to the ORDER, not to the pre-wave bytes, and a reviewer must be given the order to judge it. Lane 01 ('rule text unavailable to me', 'the authorisation status of the two grade moves' uncertified), lane 02 ('I cannot see the rulings, work orders or peer remedies the rows cite') and lane 03 ('only the controlling agent can say whether the wave was allowed to add it') each say they lacked exactly this, and that — not care — is why three thresholds appeared.

unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.onset_class_device: word-event (any of the 49), dateline (14), hand-of-YHWH (7), transport (the predicate class, 33), 'he said to me' inside a vision, ve'attah (23), messenger formula (122 + the short forms), set-your-face (9), a qinah or mashal command.
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.licensed_onset: an onset-class device that the strategy's rules make a row-grade onset AT THAT VERSE: word-event, dateline, hand, transport and 'he said to me' inside a vision (section 6 default onsets), a qinah or mashal command; a messenger formula or ve'attah ONLY under CUT-RULE (a) or (b); set-your-face never alone (section 2a).
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.close_role_signal: a VERSE-FINAL close-role formula (utterance, any recognition-family member including D3, 'I YHWH have spoken'), a genre colophon, or a vision return. Verse-final per #e14 Q2: the formula's own clause runs to the sof pasuq or is followed only by a dependent completion (36:23 shape); an independent clause after it (29:9 shape) makes it mid-verse.
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.marks_and_mid_verse_formulae: make NO face, on the row's own seams or on a rival's. They are disclosed (MARKS-3D, A9/A16) and never fatal.
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.own_seam_faces: Onset seam: near face = the row's first verse; licensed when it carries a licensed onset. Far face = the verse before; carries a signal when it ends on a close-role signal. Close seam: near face = the row's last verse; licensed when it ends on a close-role signal. Far face = the verse after; carries a signal when it carries a licensed onset or a scene change.
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.rival: an interior seam. Near face = the candidate onset verse; far face = the verse before it. LICENSED when its near face carries a licensed onset. TWO-FACED when its near face carries an onset-class device (licensed or not) AND its far face ends on a close-role signal. A rival that is neither is PARAGRAPH-GRADE.
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.HIGH: both own seams two-faced (near licensed, far signal) AND no rival that is licensed or two-faced.
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.MEDIUM: both own seams' near faces licensed but a far face carries only a mark or nothing; OR a licensed or two-faced rival is held on stated grounds.
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.MEDIUM_LOW: an own seam whose near face carries an onset-class device that is not licensed, or a discourse turn without formula, or a mid-verse formula — whatever its far face carries; or a section-7-named held question without bespoke rationale.
unified_definitions_binding_for_ezekiel_.LOW: an own seam with no onset-class device and no discernible discourse turn, or where the strategy directs low.
